Hi Jordan / Helen,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate you walking through Acme's use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

1) GDPR / DPA: Acme will require our DPA. Redwood acts as a data processor for customer workloads; we'll provide our standard DPA and the SCCs appropriate for a controller -> processor relationship. I've attached a short PDF that outlines the DPA + SCC options we typically offer.

2) SCC selection: For SaaS inference use cases where Acme is the controller and Redwood the processor, we generally apply the SCC wording intended for controller-processor relationships. If your legal team prefers specific module wording, we can surface the exact clause variants.

3) SOC 2 / security posture: We are currently undergoing SOC 2 Type II; final audit expected Q3 2027. I can share SOC 2 evidence once available and provide interim artifacts (policy summaries, architecture diagrams) for your security review.

4) HIPAA / PHI: You mentioned potential PHI in the workload. We support HIPAA-covered deployments via our Dedicated and Private deployment options and are willing to execute a BAA where required. I'll loop in our security/legal SMEs to confirm details and timelines.

5) Next steps (proposed):
- I'll send the DPA + SCC options (attached) for your legal review.
- Please send the vendor security questionnaire — I've attached our initial copy and can return answers inline.
- If Acme needs a BAA, let me know and I'll surface the BAA template & cadence for review.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_SCC-options.pdf
